A formula or medical food that is free of Phe and has a 
more appropriate amino acid, vitamin, and mineral composi-
tion for an older child is generally introduced in the toddler 
or preschool period. The criteria for introduction of these 
“next-step” formulas are that the child accept the food pattern 
and formula well and reliably consume a wide variety of foods 
from the low-Phe food list. Successful management with con-
